- **Architecture & Practices:** Clean Architecture, Domain-Driven Design (DDD), SOLID principles, Test-Driven Development (TDD), High Concurrency, Zero-Downtime Migration.

## Key Featured Projects
- **Enterprise Core Banking System:** Led full-stack architecture and frontend migration across 300+ banking branches; reduced transaction latency by 45% and improved concurrent processing by 200%.
- **Expense Tracker Mobile:** Local-first personal finance platform built with Expo, React Native, and TypeScript. Multi-currency, investment management, and zero-latency local SQLite persistence.
- **Enterprise Asset & File Management:** High-security document streaming, encrypted storage, and granular RBAC built with .NET Core, PostgreSQL, and Angular.
- **AI-Powered Hostility Detection:** Deep learning NLP model and real-time moderation pipeline using Python, PyTorch, and Next.js.
